description: Implementation of AWCContainer class managing container lifecycle, state, and communication with AWCClient within the Thunder ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle, state, and communication with AWCClient, including start, stop, and wait operations, with thread safety and state notifications.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID if container is started, otherwise 0.

methods.name: AWCContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: AWCContainer::WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Polls AWC service readiness, waiting up to 30 seconds.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters, waits for confirmation.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waits for stop confirmation or timeout.

methods.name: AWCContainer::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from AWCClient.
